build_encoder_decoder_model: build a vision encoder-decoder transformer model with configurable patch size and RoPE positional encoding
create_attention_with_rope: create a multi-head attention module with rotary positional embeddings for coordinate-aware feature processing
run_online_clustering: run online clustering with Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization to learn cluster assignments from feature embeddings
load_pretrained_vision_model: load a pretrained EncoderDecoder vision model from config and checkpoint weights onto a specified device
create_l2norm_linear_layer: create a linear layer that L2-normalizes inputs before projection with optional weight normalization
